description: Hyperliquid positions whose leverage or margin mode differs between two consecutive complete position snapshots, newest first: one row per wallet and symbol with the previous and the new leverage, margin mode, side, size and entry price. `ts` is when the later snapshot was written, not when the venue changed the setting; positions are captured about every 12 minutes, so changes arrive in batches. Without `wallet` the window defaults to the last 24 hours and is at most 31 days. `order=asc` follows the feed (stop on an empty page). Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/leverage-changes.

change.description: `up` (leverage rose), `down` (leverage fell) or `mode` (only the margin mode, `cross` or `isolated`, changed). Omit for every change.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, verbatim. It pins the call that returned it: send the same `order`, filters, `start` and `end` again, or the call is refused.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound. Default: now. A window wider than 31 days is refused unless `wallet` is given.

min_leverage.description: Smallest NEW `leverage`, 0 or more. Default 0: no floor.

order.description: `desc` (default, newest first) or `asc`, oldest first: the mode for FOLLOWING the feed. Pass each `nextCursor` back verbatim and stop on an EMPTY page, not on a null cursor (an `asc` page with rows always carries one). A row written late with an older key is not seen by a poller already past it: re-read a small overlap with `start`.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound. Default: the 24 hours before `end`, unless `wallet` is given.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. Omit for all symbols.

wallet.description: One wallet, 0x followed by 40 hex characters, any case. With it there is no default window and no 31-day cap.

name: hl_leverage_changes
title: Hyperliquid Leverage Changes
